blocker.summary: Conflicting ambient root B was created during proof execution, so clean evidence cannot be claimed.
blocker.details: B was absent before proof execution. The nested PowerShell -W2Only invocation, run with a conflicting USERPROFILE rooted at B, created profile/AppData/Local/Microsoft/PowerShell/StartupProfileData-NonInteractive. The contract forbids creation of B and forbids cleanup, retry, or replacement. No cleanup was performed. One supplemental verified_projection_ test group also rejected the deliberately conflicting TCP selector during configuration before spawn and was not retried.
blocker.required_authority: Dispatch a fresh native Windows evidence task with a new untouched ambient-conflict root and a launcher that prevents PowerShell profile-data initialization before conflicting inherited values are applied.

unclaimed: Provisioning, product pipe transport, forwarder activation, and native lifecycle work remain unclaimed.
